params.name: selection_processes[]
params.description: (Optional) IDs of the selection processes to be queried. (Returns applicants if they are at least in one selection process)

params.name: page_size
params.description: (Optional) Number of responses per page. By default, it has a value of 25 and must be within a range of [25 - 100]
